# Exponit Labs

> Exponit Labs is a focused pharmaceutical company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, delivering reliable prescription products across core therapeutic areas — Pain Management, Gastro Care, Antibiotics, and Allergy Treatment — through trusted, WHO-GMP quality-controlled manufacturing partnerships.
>
> Official Website: https://exponitlabs.test

Important: Products referenced are prescription medicines for healthcare professionals, distributors, and general trade reference. Information is provided for reference only and does not constitute medical advice.

## Core Therapeutic Areas

- [Gastroenterology](https://exponitlabs.test/products?area=gastroenterology): Prescription formulations in Gastroenterology (2 active formulations)
- [Pain](https://exponitlabs.test/products?area=pain): Prescription formulations in Pain (2 active formulations)

- [Rabonit](https://exponitlabs.test/products/rabonit): Rabeprazole+Domperidone | Therapeutic Area: Gastroenterology

## Tools & Trade Resources

- [Pharma Pricing Calculator (PTR & PTS)](https://exponitlabs.test/pricing-calculator): Interactive trade calculation tool for Indian pharmaceuticals. Computes Price to Retailer (PTR), Price to Stockist (PTS), scheme adjustments (free goods), GST tax splits (5% / 12%), and retailer/stockist profit margins.
- [Product Catalog](https://exponitlabs.test/products): Full catalog of prescription medicines with composition, strength, and packaging details.

- [Contact & PCD Franchise Inquiries](https://exponitlabs.test/contact): Trade inquiries for PCD pharma franchise, hospital supplies, stockist partnerships, and doctor sampling.
